QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_NO_STD_FUNCTIONS` they default to stubs: `calloc` returns NULL and `free` does nothing (`platform.c:24-42`). A project that forgets the setter on such a target gets NULL from its first allocation, which the library reports as an allocation failure.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the no-std defaults are stubs where calloc returns NULL and free does nothing, so an uninitialised setup fails instead of falling back to libc.
